families.decision: Organic, live, unpasteurised ferments from a named small maker, kept refrigerated.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and the words live, fermented and unpasteurised.
Check the chilled shelf and the label's keep-refrigerated instruction.
Read the ingredients for the named food, salt and any cultures or seasonings.
Pick jars naming a small farm or maker and its location.

families.decision: Organic broth made from pasture-raised bones, with the farm and animal named.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and pasture-raised or grass-fed wording.
Read the broth sublist for bones, animal species, vegetables and herbs.
Pick packs naming a small livestock farm or broth maker.
Skip ingredient lists with yeast extract, hydrolysed protein or flavour powders.

families.title: Dry seasonings and infusions
families.decision: Named, minimally processed dry seasonings and infusions from a small grower or maker.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal on herbs, tea and yeast; plain salt has no USDA Organic seal.
Read the full ingredient list for the named leaves, yeast or salt.
Pick packs naming a small grower or maker and the ingredient's origin.
Skip added flavours, colours, sweeteners and anti-caking agents in the ingredient list.

families.decision: Organic, single-ingredient sweeteners from a named farm or sugarhouse.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and the actual sweetener's name.
Read the ingredient list for the named sap, syrup or sugar alone.
Pick packs naming a small farm or sugarhouse and its region.
Skip flavoured syrups and blends listing corn syrup or artificial sweeteners.

families.decision: Organic, single-source cooking fats with their plant or animal and process named.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal on the jar, bottle or wrapper.
Read every fat in the ingredient list, including any blend.
Pick packs naming a small farm, olive estate or producer and its region.
Skip hydrogenated fats and unnamed vegetable-oil blends on the ingredient list.

families.decision: Organic single-ingredient cocoa or cacao with its growing origin named.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal, with Regenerative Organic Certified preferred.
Read the ingredient list for cocoa or cacao alone.
Pick packs naming the growing region and a small grower or grower cooperative.
Skip sweetened drinking-chocolate mixes and added flavours.

families.decision: Organic nuts and seeds labelled soaked-and-dried or sprouted, with no added oil.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and soaked-and-dried or sprouted wording.
Read the ingredients for named nuts or seeds and optional salt.
Pick sealed packs naming a grower or region and showing a best-before date.
Skip added roasting oils, sugars and sweet coatings in the ingredient list.

families.decision: Organic fruit-only preparations from a named orchard or grower.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and the fruit's name.
Read the full ingredient list for fruit alone, with water allowed in purees.
Pick packs naming a small orchard or grower and its region.
Skip sugar, syrup, oil coatings and sulphites in the ingredient list.

families.decision: Organic coconut cooking milk made with coconut and water.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and unsweetened wording.
Read the ingredient list for coconut or coconut extract and water.
Check the can for an intact seal, with no bulging, leaks or deep seam dents.
Skip added gums, emulsifiers and sweeteners in the ingredient list.

families.decision: Organic raw, unpasteurised vinegar from a named orchard or small maker.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and raw or unpasteurised wording.
Read the ingredients for the fermented fruit or wine and any added water.
Pick bottles naming a small orchard or maker and its location.
Skip caramel colour, added flavours and sweetened vinegar glazes.

families.title: Vegetable and seed condiments
families.decision: Organic vegetable or seed sauces with short, fully named ingredient lists.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal on the jar or bottle.
Read the ingredients for named vegetables or seeds, herbs and seasonings.
Pick jars naming a small farm or maker and its region.
Skip corn syrup, artificial colours and unspecified flavours in the ingredient list.

families.decision: Organic fruit preserves sweetened with honey or maple syrup from a named small maker.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and a named fruit.
Read the ingredients for fruit, honey or maple syrup and optional pectin or lemon.
Pick jars naming a small orchard or preserve maker and its location.
Skip corn syrup, artificial sweeteners and added citric or ascorbic acid.

families.decision: Organic mayonnaise with olive oil as its only oil and pasture-raised eggs.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and pasture-raised egg wording.
Read the entire oil list for olive oil alone.
Pick jars naming a small maker and its egg supplier.
Skip jars listing soybean, canola or unspecified vegetable oil alongside olive oil.

fermented.decision: Organic, live, unpasteurised vegetable ferments from a small maker, kept chilled.
fermented.delta: Sauerkraut starts with cabbage and salt; vinegar-pickled vegetables use a different process.

broth.decision: Organic pasture-raised bone broth from a named farm, chilled or frozen.
broth.delta: Frozen liquid stock comes in ready-to-thaw pouches or tubs.

salt.decision: Unrefined sea salt with salt alone listed and its source named.

sugars.decision: Organic pure maple sugar from a named small sugarhouse.
sugars.delta: Granulated maple sugar comes from further-boiled maple syrup.

maple_syrup.decision: Organic 100% pure maple syrup from a named small sugarhouse.
maple_syrup.delta: Grade A dark has a robust taste; amber has a rich taste.

cooking_oils.decision: Organic extra virgin olive oil or virgin coconut oil from a named grower.
cooking_oils.delta: Extra virgin for olive oil; virgin for coconut oil.

lard_tallow.decision: Organic pastured lard or 100% grass-fed, grass-finished tallow, with no added oils.
lard_tallow.delta: Leaf lard names the kidney fat; tallow is sold rendered rather than as raw suet.

cocoa.decision: Regenerative Organic Certified cocoa or cacao, non-alkalized and single-ingredient.
cocoa.delta: Natural or non-alkalized powder; skip 'processed with alkali'.

seeds.decision: Organic sprouted, dried seeds with the species named and no added oil.

dried_fruit.decision: Organic unsulphured dried fruit with fruit alone listed, from a named grower.
dried_fruit.delta: Unsulphured dried apricots are dark brown.

nutritional_yeast.decision: Organic, non-fortified nutritional yeast with yeast as the only ingredient.
nutritional_yeast.delta: Inactive flakes or powder; skip folic acid or B12 listed as added ingredients.

canned_coconut_milk.decision: Organic full-fat canned coconut milk listing only coconut and water.
canned_coconut_milk.delta: Compare the printed coconut percentage; choose whole or full-fat rather than lite.

dried_herbs.decision: Organic non-irradiated dried leaves from a named small herb farm.
dried_herbs.delta: Whole, cut or rubbed leaves; non-irradiated wording on the jar.

tea.decision: Organic loose-leaf herbal tea from a named small grower, with no added flavours.
tea.delta: Loose peppermint leaves make a caffeine-free infusion.

vinegar.decision: Organic raw, unpasteurised apple cider vinegar from a named small orchard.
vinegar.delta: Apple cider vinegar labelled 'with the mother'.

pasta_sauce.decision: Organic tomato sauce with olive oil and no sweetener, from a named small maker.
pasta_sauce.delta: Olive oil is the sole added oil; passata is a plain tomato base.

jam.decision: Organic fruit jam sweetened with honey or maple syrup, from a named small maker.
jam.delta: Fruit pulp or pieces distinguish jam from clear fruit jelly.

ketchup_mustard.decision: Organic live-fermented ketchup or organic mustard of seed, vinegar, water and salt.
ketchup_mustard.delta: Ketchup uses tomato puree; mustard uses mustard seed and vinegar.

mayo.decision: Look for organic olive-oil mayonnaise with pasture-raised eggs and no other oils.
mayo.delta: Garlic mayonnaise lists garlic alongside the egg-and-oil base.

groups.title: Pure maple sugar and syrup
groups.why_same: Both use the organic seal, one maple ingredient and a named sugarhouse; sugar is granulated and syrup carries a colour grade.

groups.title: Dried culinary herbs and herbal tea
groups.why_same: Both use organic named leaves, an identified grower and a plain ingredient list; whole or cut leaves suit cooking or infusion.
